crossRefs.note: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her who gives birth to her first child, the voice…
The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a besieged city.
Moreover Yahweh said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes…
therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and Yahweh will make their scalps bald.”
How has the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger! He has cast the beauty of Israel down from…
What shall I testify to you? What shall I liken to you, daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare to you, that I may…

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: I will cut off the beautiful and delicate one, the daughter of Zion.
translations.bsb: Though she is beautiful and delicate, I will destroy the Daughter of Zion.
translations.kjv: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate
translations.asv: The comely and delicate one, the daughter of Zion, will I cut off.
